hooks.name: Block em dashes in TypeScript source
hooks.description: Checks saved TypeScript/TSX files for em dash characters (U+2014) and fails if any are found in non-comment lines

action.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f=process.argv[1];const lines=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').split('\n');const hits=[];lines.forEach((l,i)=>{if(l.includes('\u2014')&&!l.trimStart().startsWith('//')&&!l.trimStart().startsWith('*'))hits.push(i+1)});if(hits.length){console.error('Em dash (\u2014) found on line(s): '+hits.join(', ')+'\nUse periods, commas, or colons instead.');process.exit(1)}" "${filePath}"
